book.name: John Iesu da bino dave John mi gagurisina.
book.commonName: John Iesu da bino dave John mi gagurisina.
book.title: John Iesu da bino dave John mi gagurisina.

content: Iesu mi embobo 5,000 unjisina.
Ango edo ainda amboda, Iesu temundo Galili ubutu kupo neida maunsisina. (Ubutu ainda dao nei awa Taiberiasi.)
Edo ine kariwa karu embomaida yai euri embo jiwae gido esitera. Awatedo embo jisi duga tuturo edo imo ambo ambo edo esitera.
Edo Iesu visido maundo peji demonda edo, ae ainda ambodani de daedo anumbesitera.
Edo iji ainde Jew embomaida Darutegari Bondo atutumbesisina.
Edo Iesu jisi piedo embomai jisi duga imo kena gupero gido Philip de sisina, “Kaende bread yai nonda oriaro embomai eiwa indari?”
Iesu matu buro ro aina awa gosisina. Ata ge awa Philip bavedo gain site sisina.
Philip mi mina ainde sisina, “Ganu
200mi bread inono mana oriaro awamane da da mi saka saka indara.”
Edo Iesu da ambodani nei, Andrew (Simon Peter da nameji) mi Iesu de sisina,
“Mai einda isira, edo ainda yai bread barley
mi ari ipa da (5) ae un wo saka tote (2) de isira. Ata nongo edo rorae emi embomai jiwaebé eiwa kondade aini?”
Edo Iesu mi sisina, “Tewo embomai anunumbore!” Edo yai ainda kinya jiwae erari isira. Awatedo embo jijianda berari 5,000 ango awa anunumbesitera.

Edo Iesu bread kundo ategari God da yai pisido, ambodanide piesiri awamanemi embomai anunumbesitera awamanede kando kando esitera. Edo dá ango un wo de esisina. Edo indari nandogo embomai jipapa ero awamanemi pipisitera.
Edo amboda awamane injido inono etero ami ainda ambodanide sisina, “Awara, ji itoto dotera awa dada ewo, da ji dowainyae.”
Awatedo awamanemi bread ipa da (5) ainda ji itoto embomaimi injido doturitera awa, dada edo kanjia berari 12 awa sirero beda esisina.
Edo iji amboda Iesu mi kariwa awa esiri gido embomaimi akuta tuturo edo mina tara esitera, “Gebé, Peroveta
awa God mi butuda piari gumaina sisina awa eire.”
Edo Iesu gira awa, awamanemi gundo imo ipami budo awamaneda daotari arate jipapa era, awatedo imo akuta tekago taigedo pejida maunsisina.
Iesu un tamonda ainto esisina.
Ango edo, turo jirido gumbiri ainda ambodani wotedo ubutuda maunsitera.
Edo muyae matu jiriri awamane mada visido gaigedo Kapenium nasi kena tepeite maunsitera. Edo Iesu awamaneda yai gumbae.
Edo bisi ikanade tupeiri ubutuda kakawa erari tuturo esisina.
Ango esiri awamane ma davedo maundo kilometre 5 o 6 ango edo awamane Iesu un tamonda ainto edo ma kena gupeiri jisi piedo gido adu esitera.
Ata inemi awamanede sisina, “Na awara; adu eoveǃ”
Edo awamanemi dubodavede imo ma doda buritera, edo ma awa burigibé yai awamane mauntera, ainda papoda denembesisina.
Iesu mi sisina, “Na awa wasiri piarida bread.”

Edo embomai ubutu kupo neida isite sipo neide erido gositera awa, muyae gisi awa ma da (1) akuta isiri Iesu da ambodanimi ma ainda vitera, edo Iesu ae ainda ambodani de daedo ma ainda vitae, ata ainda ambodanimi akuta ma ainde dodo mambera.
Edo ainda amboda ma nenei Taiberiasi edo gundo yai Badari mi ategari pisido bread kando esiri embomaimi injitera, ainda demonda denembesitera.
Edo iji ainde embomaimi Iesu ae ainda ambodani de yai ainda itae gositera, awatedo awamane daedo mada visido Iesu kakowa eite Kapenium temundo maunsitera.
Ango edo awamane maundo ubutu kupo neida imo taputera. Edo awamanemi embo ainde tedogositera, “Atopatari, imo iji nonde einda gumbesi?”

Edo Iesu mi awamanede mina sisina, “Eiwa awa gebé bajina imondemane tena. Aindabé inemane kariwa jiwae nane eteno gewa, edo na averi gewa, na kakowa ae. Ata imomane bread injido inono etewa, awatedo na kakowa ewa.

Tamopisida indari awa itae eira. Awatedo tamopisida indari akuta awaembo buro eove. Ata indari imondemane wasiri natopo itari piaina awaembo buro ewo. Indari awa Embo da Mai mi imondemane piaina. God Mamo mi ainda awara tari Mai da yai pipisisina buro awa arate.”
Edo awamanemi ainde sitera, “Nakare buro ro aro God dubodave aini?”
Iesu mi awamanede mina sisina, “God da buro awa eire: embo ave ami piesiri gupusina, ainda yai itomane gebé ari piawate.”
Awatedo awamanemi ainde sitera, “Kariwa ro ato idegari nakare jisimi gido imo gebé ari? Inemi buro ro asi?
Natokare apiye ewowomi abu damodamoda rorae dao ‘manna’ injitera. God da Ove Gaiarida tari isira awa: ‘Imo utuda edo awamaneda yai indari bread pipisisina.’ ”
Edo Iesu mi awamanede sisina, “Eiwa awa gebé bajina imondemane tena, Moses mi utuda edo imondemane bread
piae. Ata Mamo natomi utuda edo imondemane bread bé pipisira.
God da bread awa embo ave utuda edo gupeite embomai butu berarida yai wasiri pipisira.”
Edo awamanemi ainde sitera, “Embo bajina, namondekare bread eiwa iji matawa piewasi.”
Edo Iesu mi awamanede sisina, “Na awa wasiri piarida bread. Embo ainmi nato yai gupeite awa, mana beji aina, edo embo ainmi ainda gebé ari nato yai pipisite awa, mana un udo tamaina.
Ata nane imondemane gisi tetena, imomane na daedo gewa, awarata imomane gebé ae.
Edo embo avekave Mamo mi namonde piedo eira awa, berari nato yai gumbara. Edo berari ainmi nato yai gupeiari awa, nanemi mana onano mamaina.
Na utuda edo wotedo guputena awa, nato jipapa ain gumbae, ata embo ainmi na piesiri guputena ainda jipapa awa anate.
Edo Mamo na piesiri guputena, ainda jipapa awa evire, embo berari namonde pipisisina ainda da (1) nane dadoegainyae, ata deguta beao arida awamane berari jiano eraina.
Edo imo na piesiri guputena, ainda jipapa awa evire, berari ainmi Mai gosite, edo gebé ari ainda yai pipisite awa, wasiri natopo itari baina, edo nanemi deguta beao arida jiano eraina.”
Ango edo Jew embomaimi tuturo edo ge guguma gaguma ainda daoda sitera, aindabé ine sisina, “Na awa bread utuda edo wotedo guputena.”
Edo awamanemi tedo esitera, “Aee, eiwa Iesu, Joseph da mai. Ainda mamo ae ai de kaena gari. Nongo edo ine, ‘Na awa utuda edo guputena,’ ango siri?”
Awatedo Iesu mi awamanede mina sisina, “Imomane akuta ge guguma gaguma teove dowo.
Embo da ji ainda jipapami nato yai gumbari tao ae. Atako Mamo na piesiri guputena ami awa emboda do dumbari nato yai gumbarate. Edo nanemi deguta beao arida jiano eraina.
Ge Peroveta maneda Ove Gaiari
da isira awa, ‘Awamane berari God mi atopataina.’ Awatedo berari da da ain Mamo da ge ingite, edo ainda atopatari budo, nato yai gundo eira.
Edo embo da ain Mamo jisimi gae, ata imo ain God da yai edo gupusina, ami akuta Mamo gosisina.
Eiwa awa gebé bajina imondemane tena. Embo da ainmi ainda gebé ari nato yaida pipisite awa, wasiri natopo itari budo eira.
Na awa wasiri piarida bread.
Itomane apiye ewowomi abu damodamoda manna injitera, awarata, awamane bebetegesitera.
Ata bread eiwa, utuda edo wotedo gundo eiri awa, embo ainmi awa injido betainyae.

Na awa bread wasiride, utuda edo wotedo guputena. Embo ainmi bread eiwa inaina, imo wasiride natopo itaina. Edo bread nane piana awa nato pisi. Awa nane embomai butu berarida ainda wasiri awaembo piana.”
Ango tesiri Jew embomai awamane akuta tuturo edo sinigambari edo ge baieite sitera, “Embo eiwa ainda pisi nongo edo kaenato yai piari indari?”
Edo Iesu mi awamanede sisina, “Eiwa awa gebé bajina imondemane tena. Imomane Embo da Mai da pisi awa indae edo ainda ororo indae gido, imomane wasiri bari tao ae.
Embo da ainmi nato pisi indeite edo nato ororo indeite awa, wasiri natopo itari budo eira, edo deguta beao arida nane imo jiano eraina.
Gebé, nato pisi awa indaribé edo nato ororo awa indaribé.
Embo da ain nato pisi indeite edo nato ororo injido eira awa, imo nato doda isima edo eira, edo na ainda doda isima edo ena.
Wasiri piarida Mamo mi na piesiri guputena, edo inemi eiuri na wasiri budo ena. Dá ango embo da ain na injido eira, nane ano embo awa wasiri baina.
Bread eiwa utuda edo wotedo gupusina. Itomane apiye ewowomi manna injitera, awarata, awamane bebetegesitera. Ata embo da ainmi bread eiwa injido eira awa wasiride natopo itaina.”
Iesu mi ge eiwa benunu oro doda atopaposite sisina, Kapenium nasida.
Ambodani jiwae Iesu dodo maunsitera.
Awatedo ainda ambodani jiwaemi ge eiwa ingido sitera, “Eiwa awa atopatari okain edo embo da ainmi bari tao ae!”
Edo Iesu, imo akuta awa gari ainda ambodani ge eiwa ingido guguma gaguma tera. Awatedo awamanede sisina, “Ge emi eiri itomane gebé ari nato yaida dowain jipapa evita?
Edo imomane Embo da Mai tekago overegedo ainda yai utuda viviteiari gido, nongo avi?
Asisi Kotopu mi embomaide wasiri piedo eira. Tamopisimi piari tao ae. Edo ge nane tena ami itomane asisi kondade aina edo wasiri piaina.
Ata itomane doda embo nenei awa gebé ae era.” (Iesu mi tuturoda edo gosisina awa, awamane ainkain awa gebé ae ari, edo embo ainmi imo gitopo emboda ipada piaina, awatedo Iesu awa sisina.)
Edo ami tedo sisina, “Aindabé eiwa nane imondemane tetena awa, embo da ji nato yai gumbari tao ae, atako embo da ave Mamo natomi ainda yai udo ari do pipisisina.”
Ainda amboda, ainda ambodani jiwae ainde daedo tenda pepeta ae doturitera.
Edo Iesu mi ambodani 12de sisina, “Imomane daedo na dodo mamain jipapa evita?”
Edo Simon Peter mi ainde mina sisina, “Badari, nakare anda yai mambari? Wasiri natopo itarida ge ito yai isira.
Edo nakare gebé esitera edo gositera awa, imo awa Keriso, God wasirideda Mai.”
Edo Iesu mi awamanede mina sisina, “Nane imomane 12 geritena, ata itomane doregari doda embo da (1) awa Binei
mi gisijido eira!”
Iesu mi Judas da ge einda sisina, edo Judas awa Simon Iscariot da mai. Imo awa ambodani 12 ainda da (1), awarata amboda ami Iesu gitopoda ipada piaina.

footnotes.text: Ganu. Ganu einda tega awa ango emboda tau edo deguta 200 buro aina.
barley awa tambara ango, ata ainda vero awa babaingaebé.
Peroveta. Jew embomaimi Peroveta awa God mi tarigarida sisina gumaina gain edo esitera (Deuteronomy 18:18).

bread. Iesu bread evekara tote (2)da ge einda sira. Mana awa tamopisida bread God mi Israel embomaida yai pipisisina, edo bread amimi tamopisida wasiri awamanede pipisisina. Ata Iesu awa asisida bread amimi asisida wasiri embomaide pisido eira. Edo Iesu awa wasiri natopo itari tutu.

Peroveta maneda Ove Gaiari awa Jew embomaida ove gaiarida dao. Ove ainda doda awa ge God da peroveta manemi iji mamatuda gaguritera. Edo Jew embomaimi God da peroveta maneda ove gaiari dada edo dao eiwa pipisitera.
Binei awa Satan da dao nei. Anela awa God da ge jindesiri God mi imo utuda kundo augesiri idegedo wowosisina. Edo imo awa God da gitopo edo embo enemboda gitopo.
